## Revenue vs. Time

this is a short introduction to the analysis of the relationship between movie revenue and time. 



@fig-bond shows the relationship between revenue and time.

::: {#cell-fig-bond .cell execution_count=1}
``` {.python .cell-code}
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("films.csv")


bond = df[df["franchise"] == "James Bond"]


plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"])
plt.xlabel("Year")
plt.ylabel("Revenue (million USD)")
plt.show()
```
